CustomField.description: Enter the total insurance policy limit for all insurance. If no limit, enter billed charges. If self-pay enter zero. If the policy limit is unknown then put zero until it is confirmed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the maximum insurance policy limit for all insurance. If no limit, enter "unlimited". If self-pay enters "zero". If the policy limit is unknown then put "zero" until it is confirmed.Ex. $50,000 MAX
CustomField.label: Insurance Policy Limit
